cells.label: A consulting herald assists in making the submission as likely to pass as possible and/or in filling out the paperwork
cells.html: A consulting herald assists in making the submission as likely to pass as possible and/or in filling out the paperwork

cells.label: The submission is sent, with fees, to the appropriate staff herald (Submission/Internal Submission)
cells.html: <font face="Spectral">The submission is sent, with fees, to the appropriate staff herald (Submission/Internal Submission)</font>

cells.label: The appropriate staff herald compiles all submissions for a month onto an Internal Letter of Intent
cells.html: <font face="Spectral">The appropriate staff herald compiles all submissions for a month onto an Internal Letter of Intent</font>

cells.label: Commenting heralds spend approximately a month commenting on a given Internal Letter of Intent
cells.html: <font face="Spectral">Commenting heralds spend approximately a month commenting on a given Internal Letter of Intent</font>

cells.label: A meeting is held by the appropriate staff herald (Submission/External Submission) to determine whether each item, with commentary in mind, should be Returned or Forwarded
cells.html: <font face="Spectral">A meeting is held by the appropriate staff herald (Submission/External Submission) to determine whether each item, with commentary in mind, should be Returned or Forwarded</font>

cells.label: Submitter redesigns, ideally with consultation, and resubmits
cells.html: <font face="Spectral">Submitter redesigns, ideally with consultation, and resubmits</font>

cells.label: The appropriate staff herald (Submission/External Submission) compiles a Letter of Intent for commentary at the Society-wide “Laurel” level
cells.html: <font face="Spectral">The appropriate staff herald (Submission/External Submission) compiles a Letter of Intent for commentary at the Society-wide “Laurel” level</font>

cells.label: Commenting heralds spend approximately 2 months commenting on Letters of Intent
cells.html: <font face="Spectral">Commenting heralds spend approximately 2 months commenting on Letters of Intent</font>

cells.label: A meeting is held by Laurel & Staff to determine whether to accept or return each item
cells.html: <font face="Spectral">A meeting is held by Laurel & Staff to determine whether to accept or return each item</font>

cells.label: Decisions are placed on a Letter of Acceptances and Returns, which is proofread for 1–2 months
cells.html: <font face="Spectral" data-font-src="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Spectral">Decisions are placed on a Letter of Acceptances and Returns, which is proofread for 1–2 months</font>

cells.label: Item is Accepted and officially Registered!
cells.html: <font face="Spectral">Item is Accepted and officially Registered!</font>

cells.label: This is a brief overview, eliding over the systems and people that make each step happen. The College is a vast, sophisticated system full of hardworking and dedicated volunteers, many of them sight unseen.
